about_the_game:
In Qu Zone, you are stranded in an exclusion zone, a migratory area that disrupts electronics. Lost deep within the Hoh Rainforest without cell service, you need to survive long enough to find extraction and escape!

Choose from three characters, customize their stats, and play to their strengths. This roguelike, grid based strategy game gives you the freedom to survive by any means. Trade with smugglers for essentials, or battle them and forcibly take their stock. Forage edible plants, fish from the rivers, and craft using ancient native methods. Repair cell towers, drones, and weaponry and beat nature with science.

content_descriptors.notes: This game concerns survival in an area that is prone to drug smuggling. While generally avoidable, there are scenes where you fight to defend yourself from wild animals, and can optionally fight drug smugglers. The player also has the option to consume various legal and illegal drugs during their play through.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 1.4 Compatible
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: Qu Zone is a turn based roguelike based in the Hoh Rainforest. Choose a character, their stats, and play to their strengths to avoid starvation, wild animals, drug smugglers, and the cryptids of the exclusion zone.
